title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
The page image is upside down. It is the verso of a reused typescript page (numbered '- 12 -'). It is not part of Grothendieck's motivic notes on the neighbouring pages, which discuss Deuring classes, gerbes at infinity and F-crystals. The typescript is an expository treatment of analytic functions of several variables over a complete valued field K (archimedean or not), with values in a Banach space. It is in the style of Bourbaki's 'Variétés différentielles et analytiques' drafts or Serre's 'Lie algebras and Lie groups', Part II. 

First paragraph: it ends the proof of a lemma on primitives. Given power series f_k (k = 1..p) with coefficients c_{k;n} satisfying the compatibility condition D_j f_k = D_k f_j, one seeks g with D_k g = f_k and g(0) = c. The coefficients must satisfy n_k b_n = c_{k; n - e_k}, which together with b_0 = c determine the b_n uniquely. For convergence: in K one has |1/n| <= n^beta for a constant beta depending only on the absolute value. So the series with general term ((n_1+1)...(n_p+1))^beta ||a_n|| r^n converges if and only if the series with general term ||a_n|| r^n does, and the primitive has the same polyradius of convergence. 

Proposition 8 states that a holomorphic f on an open set A is strictly differentiable at each point a. For every eps > 0 there is a polydisc P_0 centred at a such that, for all u, v in P_0, ||f(u) - f(v) - sum_k D_k f(a)(u_k - v_k)|| <= eps sup_k |u_k - v_k|. The proof begins by reducing to a = 0. It then substitutes u_k + w_k into the power series (justified by 'th.2', the substitution theorem), obtains an absolutely summable series in 2p variables on P x P, and applies the associativity theorem. The page breaks off there.
errors: No mathematical errors visible. The bound |1/n| <= n^beta is correct for any absolute value on a field of characteristic 0: for an archimedean absolute value |1/n| <= 1, and in the ultrametric case |1/n| = |n|^{-1} grows at most polynomially in n.

ideas.what: Existence and uniqueness of a primitive of a compatible system of power series, with the same convergence polydisc over any complete valued field of characteristic 0, using |1/n| <= n^beta
ideas.modern_name: Integration of closed analytic 1-forms / Poincaré lemma for convergent power series over complete valued fields
ideas.where_published: Serre, Lie Algebras and Lie Groups, Part II; Bourbaki, Variétés différentielles et analytiques, Fascicule de résultats

ideas.what: Strict differentiability of holomorphic (analytic) maps into Banach spaces over a complete valued field
ideas.modern_name: Analytic implies strictly differentiable (C^1 in the strict sense)
ideas.where_published: Serre LALG Part II, ch. II; Bourbaki VAR

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a reused verso of someone else's expository typescript on elementary several-variable analytic function theory over valued fields. It is standard textbook material, unrelated to the motivic content of the neighbouring pages.
transcription_corrections: The page image is upside down (rotated 180°). It is a reverse side of reused typescript, not Grothendieck's manuscript.
In the displayed series the coefficients are written a_{n_1...n_p} (bold or script a), while the text earlier uses c and b. The transcription is consistent with the image.
'Prop. 8' uses a script f; 'D_k f(a_1,...,a_p)' is correct, with the sum over k = 1..p.
